prompt: First-person view from a wrist-mounted camera on a cobot arm looking down at its own two-finger gripper closing around a white ceramic coffee mug on a cluttered workbench. The gripper's grey aluminium fingers frame the mug's handle, and the arm's forearm link and cable harness are visible at the top of the frame. The workbench surface, a keyboard, and a stack of paper cups fill the periphery under flat overhead LED light.

Egocentric view from a robotic arm's end-effector camera looking straight down at a single red apple on a stainless-steel sorting tray. The arm's vacuum suction nozzle enters the frame from the top, descending toward the apple's skin. The tray's perforated surface and two adjacent empty slots are in sharp focus, and the food-processing plant's white-tiled floor is visible through the tray's drain holes.

Robot-eye view from a depth camera mounted on a picking arm, looking into a plastic storage tote filled with jumbled products. The arm's gripper reaches into the frame from the upper right, fingers open, targeting a single shrink-wrapped box among the clutter. A green structured-light pattern projects across the tote's contents, and the warehouse shelving and aisle markers are out of focus beyond the bin's lip.

Egocentric perspective from a shoulder-mounted camera on a palletizing robot, looking along the length of its own extended arm as the flat-plate gripper lowers a sealed cardboard carton onto a half-built pallet. The arm's orange housing and hydraulic lines dominate the left side of the frame, and the carton's shipping label and barcode are legible. The warehouse floor and yellow safety tape recede in the background.

First-person view from a camera embedded in a spot-welding gun, looking directly at the copper electrode tips pressing against a seam on a bare steel car door panel. The weld point is a bright white-orange flare at the center of the frame, and the gun's pneumatic cylinder and water-cooling hoses frame the shot from above. The door panel's pressed contours and the fixture clamps are in sharp detail around the flare.

Egocentric view from a robotic arm's wrist camera as its suction-cup crossbar descends toward a windshield lying on a glass rack. The four suction cups are visible at the bottom of the frame, approaching the windshield's tinted surface. The glass reflects the arm's joints and the factory ceiling's strip lights, and the rack's rubber-padded cradle and a stack of other windshields fill the background.

Robot-eye view from a SCARA arm's downward-facing inspection camera, looking at a single microchip held in the vacuum nozzle directly below the lens. The chip's gold pins and silicon die are in macro focus, and the circuit board socket it is about to be placed into is visible beneath, slightly out of focus. The cleanroom's white surface and ESD-safe mat fill the periphery.

Egocentric perspective from a quality-inspection cobot's wrist-mounted vision sensor hovering over a smartphone screen displaying a color-calibration grid. The screen fills most of the frame, and the arm's ring light casts an even white glow across the display. The edge of the conveyor belt and the next phone in line are just visible at the bottom of the image.

First-person view from a barista cobot's gripper camera looking down at its silicone-padded fingers wrapping around a paper coffee cup on a stainless-steel counter. The cup's cardboard sleeve and plastic lid are in sharp detail between the gripper jaws, and the espresso machine's chrome portafilter and drip tray are visible at the edge of the frame. Steam from a milk pitcher blurs the upper left corner.

Egocentric view from a delta robot's central camera looking straight down at a conveyor belt of baked goods, the robot's three parallel arms converging at the bottom of the frame where a suction picker lifts a single glazed donut from the line. The donut's sugar coating catches the overhead light, and the belt's other pastries and the stainless-steel side rails stretch into soft focus.

Robot-eye view from a cleanroom arm's end-effector camera as its custom cradle gripper lowers a single glass vaccine vial into a padded tray slot. The vial's printed label and the liquid meniscus inside are in sharp focus at the center, and the tray's other filled slots radiate outward. The sterile white countertop and a digital temperature readout are visible in the background.

Egocentric perspective from a lab cobot's wrist camera looking at its three-finger adaptive gripper carefully lifting a glass Erlenmeyer flask from a magnetic stirrer plate. The flask's conical body and the swirling liquid inside fill the center of the frame, and the gripper's silicone fingertips press gently on the glass. The stirrer's digital display and a rack of test tubes are in the peripheral background.

First-person view from a harvesting robot's end-effector camera looking through a canopy of strawberry leaves at a single ripe berry hanging from its stem. The soft-touch gripper's two silicone fingers enter the frame from opposite sides, about to close on the berry. The plant's white flowers and green unripe fruit surround the target, and the greenhouse's diffused daylight creates an even, warm illumination.

Egocentric view from a pruning robot's arm-mounted camera as its cutting tool approaches a single grapevine cane in a vineyard row. The shears' open blades frame the woody cane at the center, and the vine's tendrils and a cluster of small green grapes are in focus behind the cut point. The vineyard row recedes in a tunnel of green leaves under bright afternoon sun.

Robot-eye view from a bricklaying arm's forward camera looking along its own boom as the gripper deposits a single concrete block onto a mortar bed atop a half-built wall. The block's rough grey surface fills the lower half of the frame, and the mortar's wet sheen and the wall's previous courses are visible below. The construction site's scaffolding and a clear sky form the background.

Egocentric perspective from a welding robot's torch camera, looking through the tinted protective lens at the bright arc where the wire tip meets a steel I-beam. The weld pool glows white-hot at the center, and the bead of cooling metal trails behind in a silver line. The beam's rusty surface and the fixture clamps fill the edges, and sparks cascade downward out of the frame.

First-person view from a packing robot's overhead camera looking down at its vacuum gripper placing a single product into an open cardboard mailer box. The product's barcode label is readable, and the box's pre-folded flaps and a strip of packing tape are visible at the edges. The packing station's conveyor belt and a stack of flat-packed boxes fill the blurred background.

Egocentric view from a mobile robot arm's front-facing camera as it navigates a narrow warehouse aisle, its gripper extended toward a single yellow tote on a shelf at eye level. The tote's handle and label are in focus at the center, and the arm's forearm joint is visible at the bottom of the frame. The aisle's tall racking and overhead bar-code markers recede symmetrically into the distance.

Robot-eye view from a sewing-assist arm's needle camera looking down at a single sheet of cut denim pinched in the needle gripper's array of thin steel pins. The fabric's weave and the indigo dye are in macro detail, and the pins pierce the material at even intervals. The cutting table's ruled grid and a rotary blade rest at the periphery under cool workshop lighting.

Egocentric perspective from a paint-spraying robot's nozzle camera, looking along the fan of atomized red paint as it hits the curved surface of a car bumper on a rotating fixture. The paint mist fills the center of the frame in a soft cone, and the bumper's primer-grey surface transitions to glossy red where the spray lands. The booth's white walls and filtered ceiling are hazed with fine overspray at the edges.
